source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Heat up the sensor until higher than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All TEMP_MB_CPU0~1 should get pass result.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo ipmitool sdr elist 2>&1; echo ---; sudo ipmitool sensor list 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return full `ipmitool sdr elist` + `ipmitool sensor list` for TEMP_MB_CPU0~1 so user confirms the sensor reading is present, changes normally with temperature, thresholds match spec, and SEL shows correct assert/deassert log. No RISK (read-only).

original_test_intent: Exercise both motherboard CPU0 and CPU1 temperature sensors through thresholds and verify per-socket SDR, SEL and protection behavior.
original_method: Engineer heats/loads each CPU path while ipmitool observes aggregate sensor and SEL data.
manual_activity: Engineer controls per-socket workload/thermal setup; automated collection must prove each CPU sensor independently.
required_inputs: CPU0/CPU1 sensor names and socket mapping
safety_requirements: Never assume range syntax enumerates actual sensors.
Stop on critical temperature, throttling beyond plan, fan/power anomaly or telemetry loss.
Trusted access only; no auto retry.
agent_execution_scope: Poll each mapped CPU sensor plus SEL/throttle/fan/power/console and produce per-socket results.
Do not apply heat or decide verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Baseline-only; aggregate output cannot prove both socket paths and unsafe SSH is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Trusted per-sensor polling plus CPU/socket workload telemetry and independent temperature.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Commands, CPU0~1 scope, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Enumerate CPU0/CPU1 sensors, stimulate one bounded socket path at a time, correlate warning/critical events, throttling and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CPU thermal and SEL mapping.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents one sensor from satisfying both.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CPU load can throttle or shut down host.
